question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute a tankless water heater in lieu of the storage-type unit specified in Section 22 34 00 prior to ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use a tankless alternate in lieu of the specified storage-type water heater.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: The request concerns a plumbing equipment substitution under Section 22 34 00, requiring plumbing engineering review of performance and code compliance.
